findings.note: The committed summary receipt is internally consistent with the reported 4 worlds × 2 donor counts × 40 draws design.

findings.interpretation: The repaired synthetic measured-depth world is rejected by the frozen balance gate in all 80 draws. This supports retracting the old V1 depth alarm for the frozen matched-control fixture.
findings.limit: This is synthetic qualification of the planted measured-depth world, not proof that every possible technical confound is controlled in real data.

findings.interpretation: Effect magnitude alone does not separate this planted hidden-confound world from planted biology.

findings.evidence: stage4_executor_v1.py implements a two-sided 95% donor-bootstrap CI containing zero and explicitly records that the contract did not specify the test or level.
findings.consequence: V2 G2 pass/rejection rates must not be promoted to properties of the frozen scientific design until G2 semantics are prospectively specified.

evidence: runner reads K from the precommit rather than choosing it internally
runner re-reads confound_blocks_K from each world manifest and stops on mismatch
matching-rule build failures stop rather than being excluded
biology reference values are hard-coded as citations to V2 rather than re-derived
findings.limit: No committed K-curve result exists at the audited head; this is software/design audit only.

findings.evidence: The committed phase_b_design directory contains the aggregate V2 sweep receipt and precommit, but the audit did not find a repo-resident per-draw ledger containing all 320 individual draw records.
findings.consequence: The 320-draw aggregate is internally consistent and bound to a precommit, but an independent GitHub-only audit cannot reconstruct every count from individual committed draw records. Preserve this limitation rather than describing the aggregate as independently re-counted.

overall: V2 aggregate arithmetic and the major S99/S102 interpretations are supported by the committed receipt/code. The depth-alarm retraction is justified for the planted repaired fixture. General hidden-confound protection and the final G2 rule remain unresolved. Stage4 remains closed.
